_comment: Merge this 'port' section into the project's .ghostslice.json. Keys are exactly the ones ghostport.profile accepts: pack, budget_tokens, test_command, merge, pin_first, order, pattern_overrides. Any other key in the port section fails loudly with a ProfileError, so do not rename them. GhostSlice ignores sections it does not own only if its loader allows them, so check `ghostslice doctor` after merging.
